programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.8
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Serieously Ep.29
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Lady Gun Fighter
programme.desc: Une femme lutte pour retrouver son fils kidnappé, affrontant un monde inconnu.

programme.title: Entre les jambes
programme.desc: Tout commence lors d'une réunion des sexopathes anonymes où Javier et Miranda se rencontrent. Javier, scénariste-producteur, avait un avenir brillant jusqu'au jour où il s'est livré à un jeu sexuel au téléphone qui a détruit son mariage et Miranda, animatrice d'une émission radio.

programme.title: Misfits club
programme.desc: Valeria vient juste de déménager à Madrid après la séparation de ses parents. Nouvelles amitiés, une ville aux multiples opportunités, premier amour… Des expériences fortes qui changera à jamais la vie de Valeria et de son groupe d'amis.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: One Last Dance
programme.desc: À la suite d'une tragédie, une compagnie de danse renommée de New York est au bord de l'effondrement. Après avoir quitté le monde de la danse pour de bon, Travis, Chrissa et Max ont une dernière chance de renouer avec leur passion et de prouver que les miracles peuvent toujours arriver.

programme.title: Lessons in love
programme.desc: Jack Marcus, ancien écrivain à succès, enseigne la littérature à des élèves davantage intéressés par les réseaux sociaux. Lassé par son travail et sarcastique avec ses collègues, Jack trouve lentement refuge dans l'alcool.

programme.title: Un Noël de Roman
programme.desc: La romancière cynique Dru Cassadine, connue pour ses histoires d'amour, cherche désespérément à percer après une série d'échecs. Poussée par des critiques brutales et la menace de son éditeur de la laisser tomber, elle n'a que quelques semaines pour écrire un best-seller.

programme.title: Le Noël du cœur
programme.desc: Après avoir gagné un prix de 50 000 dollars, un homme décide de rendre la pareille en achetant des cadeaux de Noël à des inconnus sous le pseudonyme de « Lucky the Elf ».

programme.title: The Tracker
programme.desc: Spears, détective privé basé à Los Angeles, apprend que son ex, Kim, s'est fait kidnapper par la Mafia Chinoise. Alors qu'il ne souhaite pas s'mpliquer, ses sentiments pour Kim le poussent à retourner à New York pour la sauver.

programme.title: Le Ravisseur
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un policier apparemment exemplaire enlève et emprisonne secrètement une belle danseuse, une bataille mortelle s'engage entre le ravisseur et la captive.

programme.title: Darkweb
programme.desc: Un couple de vidéastes organise des parties de chasse pour les millionnaires en quête de sensations fortes.

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: Dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, les forces saxonnes venues de l'Est attaquent le peuple celte.

programme.title: Fire Girls
programme.desc: Un tueur à gages célèbre de L.A. tombe amoureux de sa cible.

programme.title: Beyond the Sky
programme.desc: Au cours du tournage d'un documentaire sur les mensonges des enlèvements par des aliens.

programme.title: Les ex de mon mec
programme.desc: Stacy, une jeune journaliste en herbe, découvre, en regardant dans l'organizer électronique de son petit ami, qu'il a eu avant elle une suite de relations sentimentales incroyables avec, entre autres, un superbe mannequin et la voisine de palier. Elle décide de toutes les rencontrer...

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Doug Kinney, contremaitre dans une entreprise de construction, est gagne par le stress. Son travail ne lui laisse aucun repit et il a a peine le temps de voir sa femme et ses deux enfants, qu'il adore. Il trouve une solution a tous ces problemes quand il fait la connaissance d'un chercheur en genetique qui lui propose de creer un clone, un autre lui-meme.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: Michael est un comédien talentueux mais sans travail. Quand sa petite amie, Sandy, rate une audition pour un feuilleton télé, il se travestit en femme et obtient le rôle sous le nom de Dorothy Michaels. Il devient rapidement le confident de Julie, l'actrice avec qui il partage la vedette. Mais il en tombe bientôt amoureux et malheureusement, le père de Julie tombe aussi amoureux... de Dorothy.

programme.title: Oncle Drew
programme.desc: Un jeune propriétaire d'équipe et l'Oncle Drew (la star de la NBA Kyrie Irving) rassemblent l'ancienne équipe de basket de Drew pour prouver qu'un groupe de septuagénaires peut encore gagner.

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête.

programme.title: How It Ends
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie apocalyptique positive, Liza (Zoe Lister-Jones) s'embarque dans un voyage hilarant à travers Los Angeles pour tenter de rejoindre la dernière fête avant la fin du monde, rencontrant des personnages éclectiques en chemin.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Stuart Little est de retour dans une nouvelle comédie pleine d'action et d'aventure. Avec tous vos personnages préférés du premier film, mais aussi des nouveaux – et encore plus d'effets spéciaux incroyables. STUART LITTLE 2 ose aller là où aucune souris n'est jamais allée auparavant !

programme.title: Ni repris ni échangé
programme.desc: Valentin est un playboy vivant à Acapulco. un jour, une ancienne maitresse laisse sur le seuil de sa porte un bébé supposé être sa fille, et part sans autre explication.Il quitte alors le Mexique pour Los Angeles dans l'espoir de retrouver la mère de la petite fille...

programme.title: Les colts de la violence
programme.desc: Il y a douze ans, Sartana a fait accuser son frère Johnny de meurtre et lui a volé sa petite amie.

programme.title: Fort invincible
programme.desc: Un commandant de cavalerie méprisé est injustement blâmé par sa troupe pour la mort d'un officier populaire et doit se racheter.

programme.title: L'Héritage du chercheur d'or
programme.desc: Rod Drew part à la recherche d'une jeune fille disparue et se retrouve également impliqué dans une bataille pour une mine d'or.

programme.title: Des dollars plein la gueule
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes nommé Amen est engagé par un groupe de nonnes pour récupérer de l'argent volé.

programme.title: La course au soleil
programme.desc: Lorsque Charlotte Sutter est enlevée par des Apaches, son frère Sam, aidé par un vieux prospecteur ivre, part à sa recherche.

programme.title: Le mécano de la Générale
programme.desc: Lorsque des espions de l'Union volent la locomotive adorée d'un ingénieur, celui-ci la poursuit seul et directement à travers les lignes ennemies.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Mémoires Diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Vampires
programme.desc: Un savant met au point un sérum capable de transformer les humains en vampire. Une des victimes résiste au sérum et tente d'arrêter le savant et ses acolytes avant qu'il ne contamine le monde.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Tandis qu'un commando d'élite de l'armée américaine tend une embuscade à des rebelles, le professeur Lovecraft guide plusieurs de ses élèves dans une mission archéologique. Une étudiante est attaquée par un ptérodactyle.

programme.title: Bounty Killer
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes débarque dans une petite ville pour récupérer une récompense. Une jeune femme le recrute alors pour régler un problème local.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Après qu'une pandémie virale a frappé le monde, John Wood a laissé derrière lui les vestiges d'une civilisation brisée pour retourner à ses racines dans les bois.

programme.title: Enlèvement

programme.desc: Une auteure prônant l'émancipation découvre qu'un fan obsessionnel la traque.

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Jeune pilote prometteuse, son seul espoir est son frère, ancien champion de rallye devenu drogué.

programme.title: Marionnette
programme.desc: Une thérapeute perd le contrôle de la réalité face à un garçon affirmant pouvoir contrôler son avenir.

programme.title: Escadron 303
programme.desc: Au cœur de la bataille d'Angleterre, un groupe de pilotes polonais exilés refuse de plier face à l'ennemi nazi. Entre courage, sacrifice et esprit de revanche, l'escadron 303 s'impose comme une force aérienne redoutable, prête à tout pour défendre le ciel britannique.

programme.title: Kickboxer: L'héritage
programme.desc: Juste après avoir remporté un combat à Las Vegas, Kurt Sloane est mis sous sédatifs et emmené dans une prison de Bangkok, où il devra combattre un géant pour regagner sa liberté et 1 million de dollars.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis
programme.desc: Durant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, l'équipage d'un navire américain lutte pour survivre après son naufrage en pleine mer.

programme.title: Frayeurs
programme.desc: Trois jeunes gens tentent de conjurer la malédiction attachée à la mort d'un prêtre, qui, selon une prophétie, précède l'ouverture des portes de l'Enfer.

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Demon City Shinjuku
programme.desc: Dix ans après qu'un sorcier maléfique, Rebi Ra, a transformé Shinjuku en une ville démoniaque, un jeune combattant nommé Kyoya est contraint d'affronter cet ennemi redoutable. Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: Tuer pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un mercenaire tente de se racheter après avoir été l'homme de main impitoyable d'un syndicat.

programme.title: Les Révoltés
programme.desc: Dans une Amérique devenue cauchemar totalitaire, une milice dextrême droite appelée les Volontaires traque, grâce à un système de code-barres, tous ceux qui ne correspondent pas à son idéal identitaire. Un petit groupe damis tente alors une fuite désespérée vers le Canada.

programme.title: Apocalypse of Ice
programme.desc: En pleine pandémie mondiale, un vortex menace de recouvrir la Terre de glace

programme.title: Arctic Armageddon
programme.desc: Les températures chutent et plongent le monde dans un chaos glacial. Résistant aux conditions les plus extrêmes, le sous marin USS 598 Dallas et son équipage vont alors tenter l'impossible.

programme.title: Battlestar Rebellion
programme.desc: Un cosmonaute découvre une planète régie par les Pères Inconnus, cinq gouverneurs anonymes dictateurs..

programme.title: Insurrection
programme.desc: Une histoire d'amour, de sang et de violence en pleine insurrection de Varsovie de 1944...

programme.title: Street Fighter: Assassin's Fist
programme.desc: Ken et Ryu découvrent le passé mystérieux de leur maître, Gouken.

programme.title: Hirokin: Le dernier Samurai
programme.desc: Hirokin a un dilemme: venger le meurtre de sa famille ou lutter pour la liberté d'un peuple.

programme.title: Lake Placid : Héritage
programme.desc: De jeunes explorateurs s'aventurent sur un mystérieux lac retiré des cartes modernes, en quêtes de secrets à explorer. Ils y découvrent une île dans laquelle se trouve un laboratoire abandonné, mais s'aperçoivent qu'elle abrite quelque chose de terrifiant : un prédateur des plus mortel. Avant même qu'ils n'aient temps de faire demi-tour, nos aventuriers sont pris au piège. Ils vont rapidement devoir mettre leur rivalité de côté pour réagir ensemble, s'ils veulent avoir la moindre chance de rester en vie…

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary (Taraji P. Henson), une dangereuse tueuse à gages, travaille pour la famille du crime la plus célèbre de la ville, dirigée par Benny (Danny Glover). Lorsque Mary tue un mafieux sous protection pour sauver un jeune garçon, elle doit faire face à de nombreux criminels de renom, y compris son ancien amant. Armée de son ingéniosité - et d'un placard rempli d'armes - Mary doit faire le nécessaire pour survivre…

programme.title: Anacondas
programme.sub-title: À la poursuite de l'orchidée de sang
programme.desc: Un groupe de scientifiques décide de s'embarquer dans un voyage périlleux à la recherche d'une orchidée très rare qui pourrait détenir un sérum pour préserver la jeunesse. Mais l'expédition s'avère bien plus périlleuse que prévue. De redoutables prédateurs protègent l'orchidée et son terrible secret.

programme.title: LeLagon Bleu
programme.desc: Après que leur bateau se soit échoué, deux jeunes enfants se retrouvent seuls et isolés sur une île déserte. Ils grandissent ensemble et des sentiments commencent à les envahir.

programme.title: Alpha (2018)
programme.desc: En Europe, il y a 20 000 ans, durant l'ère Paléolithique supérieur, un jeune homme part braver une nature dangereuse et inhospitalière afin de retrouver le chemin de sa tribu.

programme.title: La guerre de l'ombre
programme.desc: Les années 1980, Irlande du Nord. Martin McGartland, 22 ans, tente de gagner sa vie en faisant du porte-à-porte. Il reçoit alors deux offres de camps opposés : l'IRA le veut dans son armée et les Anglais lui proposent de devenir l'un de leurs espions…

programme.title: Respect

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode is about on the most ancient and majestic animal of the continent: the muskox seems like the last survivor of the ice age – and it is. Thousands of years ago the animals roamed our landscapes together with mammoths. Nowadays, the only remaining herds live in Scandinavia: the Dovrefjell National Park in Norway and the Härjedaalen area in Sweden - where scientists and environmentalists put up a breeding centre in order to protect and strengthen the wild population of muskox - are the main locations of this episode.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Magic Lakes
programme.desc: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it's far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2 lakes alone. Thanks to the Müritz National Park the species diversity is particularly high in the region: half of the German crane population breeds in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern the osprey is typical of the Müritz area the lively Eurasian otter hunts here and the endangered red milan circles the skies above. Fred Bollmann knows the national park like hardly any other. The former ranger and voluntary nature conservationist is actively involved in the preservation of ‘his' wildlife world. Filming for this production took two years. The outcome is a unique portrait of this stunning region.

programme.title: The Seychelles
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife film-makers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In Alaska a cunning grizzly threatens the son of Andreas Kieling, on the remote Wrangel Island in northern-east Siberia his colleague Uwe Anders is taken by surprise by a a polar bear, and off the coast of South Africa a diving-team is unexpectedly surrounded by white sharks. But the life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, life-threatening diseases and failing technical equipment: Deep in the vast rainforests of West Africa cameraman Klaus Scheurich nearly dies of malaria, and in South India a film team narrowly escapes death in a hot-air balloon accident. But they also meet remarkable people such as a zoo keeper in Cameroon who feels at ease playing with half-grown and adult gorillas - the most powerful of all great apes. The first episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. A cunning grizzly grabs a salmon off Andreas Kieling's fishing rod, in the depths of the Amazon River a diving team has a spooky encounter with piranhas, in the Mediterranean Sea the currents nearly push Thomas Behrend into the mouths of angry sperm whales defending a newborn - and cameramen who want to film jaguars in the dense jungle of South America become easy prey for the well camouflaged cats. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces and failing technical equipment: In the swamps of North Australia violent storms hold up the crossing of tearing rivers, a volcano in the South Seas spits burning lumps of lava into the base camp, and in Siberia a camera team breaks through the ice and has to camp at minus 30°C in the middle of nowhere. The second episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife-filmmakers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In the Kruger National Park Josef Jozefowicz steps into a lionesses' den to film her cubs, in Alaska Andreas Kieling mingles with giant elk bulls in order to film them in action, and in Florida his colleague Zoltan Török gets very close to an alligator mother guarding its nest. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, and failing technical equipment: the strong and tearing current of the Yukon River throws Andreas Kieling's boat onto a gravel bank, in the Democratic Republik of Congo camerawoman Heike Grebe is separated from her colleagues in the dense rainforest, in Kamchatka a film team only just escapes a gigantic landslide, and in Finland a hot-air balloon catches fire and becomes the nightmare of Oliver Goetzl and Ivo Nörenberg. The last episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: After a daring mission to save their friend in the Dream World, Mateo and Izzie find the nightmare has followed them back to the Waking World.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Spooky Sensation
programme.desc: The girls decided to spend a weekend at the hotel. It appears to be haunted. Watch the full video to know more about this.

programme.title: Sings of Love

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: BODRUM & CAPPADOCIA: NATURE, RESILIENCE, AND REINVENTION
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey from the ancient seaside ruins of Bodrum to the soaring, hand-carved peaks of Cappadocia to explore how the past finds new purpose in the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins on the Aegean coast in Bodrum, a city where ancient history catches the breeze through 15th-century windmills and the fortress of Bodrum Castle. Guided by local experts, the hosts explore the Myndos Gate, where the armies of Alexander the Great once clashed, and uncover the legacy of Princess Ada, one of the world's earliest female leaders. The episode highlights how these ancient spaces, including the grand marble theater, remain alive today as world-class venues for modern performance. The exploration then crosses east into Cappadocia, a landscape sculpted by fire and wind over millions of years. From the vantage point of a hot air balloon at sunrise, the team witnesses a bird's eye view of the region's famous fairy chimneys before descending into the Ozkonak Underground City—a nine-level subterranean complex built for ancient survival. The journey concludes at the Cappadocia Cave Suites, where the hosts meet the pioneering family who transformed their ancestral cave homes into a global tourism landmark, proving that Türkiye's story is still being written by the people who walk its ancient paths.

programme.title: THE HEARTBEAT OF DENVERV
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the transformation of Denver, Colorado, from a frontier legend to a modern cultural pioneer, discovering how old western grit meets new ambition in the place they call home. The journey begins in the shadow of the Rockies, where the hosts explore the 'Queen City of the Plains' and its history of constant reinvention. Guided by civic leaders including Mayor Mike Johnston, the episode explores Denver's progressive legacy—from its early adoption of women's suffrage to its rise as a national innovation hub. The narrative also examines the city's modern 'green rush,' detailing how the 2014 legalization of marijuana transformed the state's economy, generating over $1.2 billion in tax revenue and creating a new frontier for medical and recreational tourism. The hosts pay homage to the area's first inhabitants, acknowledging that the land Denver sits on originally belonged to the Arapaho, Cheyenne, and Ute peoples. This cultural thread leads to the iconic Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, a geological wonder formed 300 million years ago and designated a National Historic Landmark. By tracing the city's history from ancient indigenous winter camping sites to world-renowned concert stages, the journey proves that the modern West is wiser, more inclusive, and still full of adventure.

Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM GURUDWARA SRI SIS GANJ SAHIB
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: SADHAK KAMALAKANTA
programme.desc: Sadhak Kamalakanta is a religious depiction of the extraordinary life of the saint Kamalakanta, from approximately the 15th century of undivided Bengal. As per the Hindu mythology, it is believed by many that Kamalakanta was blessed by the divine spirit of the Mother Goddess, in the images of not only Kali and Durga but also Jagatamba, Bishlakhi and Bhabani. It movie tells of his days as a boy where he was granted the skills of a learned hermit from a holy man, and that was the initiation into a life of religious belief. It portrays all hardships that Kamalakanta faced in his family life and criticism of the public, to have to choose between a family to take care of and the undeterred devotion to the Mother Goddess. The movie intends to spread the message hof Kamalakantaís teachings of love and peace and spiritual importance as a way of life rather than a blind religion of sorts that we follow.

programme.desc: In this movie with Anirban, Ritu, and Mon moving forward, we see a love triangle. Where the mon loves Anirban like crazy and she thinks in her mind that if Anirban is not hers then she will not allow Anirban to be anyone else. Ritu, on the other hand, loves Anirban in her heart but can't say anything. In the cycle of events, Mon had to leave Kochbihar with her family and move to another place and at that time Anirban also went to Calcutta to take a photography course. When he returns 3 years later, falls in love with Ritu and they get married. Ritu's mother can't accept it. On the other hand, after getting this news, mon wants to take revenge by separating Anirban and Ritu. Mon returns to Kochbihar and is able to separate Anirban and Ritu. But even after they are separated, Anirban does not accept mon, as a result, mon goes crazy.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.1
programme.desc: In the Moonlight Garden, rumored to be home to ancient mountain spirits, the guardian god of Jiri Mountain, Gu Wol Ryung, roams the human world. When Yoon Cham-pan is falsely accused of treason and executed, his daughter, Seo Hwa, is sold off as a gisaeng.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.2
programme.desc: Having given his heart to Seo Hwa, Gu Wol Ryung wishes to give up his immortal life to become human. He seeks to obtain the Gu Family Book by observing three taboos. Wol Ryung and Seo Hwa hold their own wedding and spend happy days in the Moonlight Garden, but Jo Gwan Woong remains relentless in his search for the missing Seo Hwa.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.3
programme.desc: Following Buddhist Monk So Jung's advice, Park Mu Sol adopts and raises Kang Chi. Afterward, he succeeds in all his endeavors, building the Hundred Year Inn, the best in the south. Now an adult, Kang Chi causes trouble while trying to stop the marriage of his first love, Chung Jo.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.4
programme.desc: Jo Gwan Woong visits the Hundred Year Inn. Tae Seo politely informs him there are no empty rooms, but Gwan Woong becomes enraged and causes a scene. Kang Chi, who had been kicked out by Lady Yoon, hears the news and, after some conflict, returns to confront Jo Gwan Woong.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.5
programme.desc: Kang Chi and Yeo Wool are attacked by dark shadows. Kang Chi, unfamiliar with such opponents, is cut multiple times while fighting back. Hearing Kang Chi is injured, Chung Jo visits him out of worry, and they share an affectionate hug. Yeo Wool witnesses their embrace.

programme.title: Kangchi, The Beginning Ep.6
programme.desc: Enraged by Jo Gwan Woong's atrocities, Kang Chi's eyes turn red, and he lunges at him. Jo Gwan Woong frames Park Mu Sol for high treason and Kang Chi for murder.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Motte! Motte burst into the music scene in September 2017 with the single Tickin' Then in 2018 she released her first full-length album Between and got nominated for Best Rookie at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. With her stage name based on the Harry Potter saga's villain Voldemort she sings about the struggles loneliness and many other things that today's youth experiences. She's been also actively expanding her reach in the music industry taking part in the soundtracks of A-TEEN Romance Is a Bonus Book My Strange Hero and When the Camellia Blooms as well as the Beautiful Mint Life Festiva and the Let's Rock Festival. Last but not least she's dubbed the idol of the indie scene thanks to her cute appearance. In this episode Motte performs Don't Run Away Non-Alcohol Fireplace and more to showcase the essence of her musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: "A" is on the menu and Chef Robert Jewell takes on this meal challenge with apricots and avocados. First up, Robert cooks a spicy roasted quail and drizzles it with some sweet apricot and calvados sauce. Next, is a meal best served cold! Robert slices up sushi-grade tuna and transforms it into a flavourful tartare, brought to life by rich avocado and refreshing lime. On the side, he adds crusty crostini with savoury soy sauce and sesame oil, the perfect complement for this meltin- your-mouth meal. For his final dish, Robert combines apricots and avocados for an unbelievably tasty dish.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Host Theresa Visintin picks the letter “D” in this challenge and combines two very different ingredients – dill and duck! But that's no big dill for Theresa. For her first dish, Theresa uses dill seeds and weed to make a hearty, creamy dill pickle soup. She adds chicken broth and potatoes as her base but makes the soup extra smooth with some sour cream. She tops the soup with dill pickles to add a delightful crunch. Next, Theresa takes duck, a classic French ingredient, and gives it a French Canadian twist – duck tourtière. Using the duck fat to fry up some veggies, she adds red wine to her chicken stock and simmers the meat. Then, Theresa fills a pie crust with this delightful duck filling and coats the crust with egg wash before baking it to a golden brown. Finally, Theresa takes on both ingredients to create a delectable dill and duck dish.

programme.title: Il prete sposato
programme.desc: Un giovane prete da poco arrivato in Sicilia si ritrova catapultato nelle spregiudicatezze locali, rivelategli in confessionale, soprattutto dalle donne. A causa di queste continue tentazioni, la sua fede inizia a vacillare. Le cose non migliorano affatto quando Silvia, una prostituta di paese, si presenta in confessionale e settimanalmente gli elenca i suoi "peccati".

programme.title: Lo sciupafemmine
programme.desc: Peppino, italiano in Brasile, lavora nella ditta del cugino Carlo, prossima al fallimento. Solo un imprenditore tedesco, Lacter, potrebbe salvare l'azienda, così Peppino paga una prostituta perché seduca Lacter fingendo di essere Lucia, la moglie di Carlo. Ma il tedesco ha in realtà già conosciuto Lucia, dando inizio a una spassosa girandola di equivoci.

programme.title: Joko, invoca Dio e muori
programme.desc: Joko cerca di sottrarre il carico a un gruppo di banditi con la complicità di un paio di uomini, ma il piano fallisce e l'uomo arriva alla resa dei conti con il capo della banda rivale.

programme.title: La settimana al mare
programme.desc: Un divertentissimo cult della commedia italiana anni '80 con Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Annamaria Rizzoli e Vincenzo Crocitti. Carlo, studente universitario, è figlio unico e sua madre Elvira, per proteggerlo, lo ha reso timido e indifeso. Il padre Antonio decide allora d'intervenire e, all'insaputa della moglie, porta il figlio in vacanza con sé in un villaggio turistico.

programme.title: Una vacanza del cactus
programme.desc: Divertentissima commedia sexy all'italiana con i mitici Anna Maria Rizzoli, Enzo Cannavale e Bombolo. Un gruppo di cinque persone si appresta a una vacanza sull'isola di Rodi, in Grecia: tra loro c'è il bonario Augusto, che intende portare un cactus sulla tomba dello zio Michele. Quest'ultimo, in realtà, è un truffatore che, ricercato a Roma, si è rifugiato sull'isola sotto il nome di Kemal.

programme.title: Manhunt
programme.desc: Accusato di crimini atroci che non ha commesso, un pubblico ministero parte in missione per riabilitare il suo nome.

programme.title: Lo sciacallo: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Louis non riesce a trovare lavoro. Un giorno assiste per caso a un incidente stradale e ha un'illuminazione: si procura una videocamera e da quel momento passa le notti correndo sui luoghi delle emergenze, per riprendere le scene più cruente e vendere il materiale ai network televisivi.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronauta Roy McBride (Brad Pitt) viaggia fino ai lontani confini del sistema solare per trovare il padre scomparso e dipanare un mistero che minaccia la sopravvivenza del nostro pianeta.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All'inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: Chestnut
programme.desc: Le giovani sorelle orfane Sal e Rae pensano di aver fatto centro quando trovano un adorabile cucciolo di alano il giorno stesso in cui vengono informate che saranno adottate... ma presto scopriranno che nel loro nuovo elegante appartamento a Manhattan i cani non sono ammessi.

programme.title: Team Hot Wheels: La nascita di un mito
programme.desc: Nella cittá piú tranquilla del mondo, quattro ragazzi fortunati scopriranno che la vita è piú divertente quando si va a tutto gas! Gage, Wyatt, Brandon e Rhett sono nati per correre. Da soli sono piloti abilissimi, ma insieme diventano Il Team Hot Wheels®!

programme.title: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: La vera storia di Robinson Crusoe raccontata dal pappagallo Venerdì che sull'isola è diventato il suo migliore amico.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E1 Episodio 1 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a un frigorifero, un tostapane, un copertone e tanti altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E2 Episodio 2 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a un puzzle, un trenino, un cestino e tanti altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E3 Episodio 3 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a una lampadina, una piastra, un Forza 4 e altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E1 Episodio 1 - Chicky e Bekky suonano uno strumento a corde. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E2 Episodio 2 - Chicky e Poyo saltano più e più volte da un divertente trampolino rosa. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E3 Episodio 3 - Chicky e Bekky scoprono un oggetto divertente con dei quadrati illuminati. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.desc: S2:E4 Il mistero dello spettro - Quando Burbero pensa che il suo nascondiglio sia infestato, chiede aiuto agli orsetti. Gli orsetti non credono ai fantasmi… finché non si ritrovano faccia a faccia con uno! Solo quando Condivisione affronta le sue paure riescono a venire a capo di questa inquietante situazione!

programme.title: Il carabiniere a cavallo
programme.desc: Spassosa commedia con Nino Manfredi e Annette Stroyberg. Il carabiniere Bartolomucci vuole sposare in segreto la sua fidanzata visto che il regolamento accademico gli proibisce di farlo prima di aver compiuto 15 anni di servizio. Ma proprio alla vigilia delle nozze, qualcuno gli ruba il cavallo. Nel giorno del suo matrimonio, il carabiniere farà di tutto per trovarlo. Diretta da Carlo Lizzani.

programme.title: Guardatele ma non toccatele
programme.desc: Un aereo militare con venti uomini a bordo deve atterrare in seguito ad avaria al motore. Il comandante del campo chiama a rapporto il maresciallo La Notte ed ordina che ai militari americani in arrivo sia assegnata la camerata degli avieri. L'ordine provoca scontento, che si trasforma in gioia quando dall'aereo americano scendono venti avvenenti ausiliarie, capitanate da Rebecca O'Connor.

programme.title: Una storia moderna: l'ape regina
programme.desc: Prima opera italiana del regista Marco Ferreri con i celebri Ugo Tognazzi, Walter Giller e Marina Vlady. Il quarantenne Alfonso riesce finalmente a sposare Regina, vergine, educata, bella e molto cattolica. Quando Regina inizia a mettergli pressione perché vuole avere un bambino, l'uomo si ammala e, raggiunto l'obiettivo, Regina inizierà a trascurarlo fino a causare un drammatico evento.

programme.title: Il Commissario Pepe
programme.desc: Il commissario Pepe (Ugo Tognazzi) riceve l'incarico di indagare su un giro di prostituzione che interessa la tranquilla cittadina in cui lavora. Durante le indagini, scopre che molte persone insospettabili sono coinvolte, ma viene invitato dal questore a chiudere un occhio per evitare uno scandalo. Una commedia di Ettore Scola, con le musiche di Armando Trovajoli.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Omicidio!
programme.desc: Un'affascinante donna, aspirante attrice, viene accusata di omicidio. Uno dei giurati incaricati di deliberare sul suo caso crede nella sua innocenza e inizia ad investigare per identificare il vero assassino.

programme.title: Le ore dell'amore
programme.desc: Gianni e Maretta, che hanno vissuto insieme per tre anni, decidono di sposarsi. Nonostante essi conducano una vita agiata, il matrimonio si rivela per Gianni una situazione insopportabile. Maretta tenta ogni cosa per salvare l'unione, ma si scontra col carattere frivolo e superficiale del marito. Di reciproco accordo decidono così di tornare a vivere da amanti come avevano fatto prima di sposarsi. Una scappatoia che entrambi ritengono necessaria per salvare il salvabile.

programme.title: Nella casa
programme.desc: Un sedicenne si introduce nella vita di una famiglia borghese e ne scrive per un compito scolastico. Il suo saggio provoca una serie di eventi inaspettati che mettono in crisi relazioni e segreti, sfidando i confini tra realtà e finzione

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Regali da uno Sconosciuto
programme.desc: Dal produttore di "Scappa - Get Out" e "BlacKkKlansman", un thriller imperdibile con Joel Edgerton (Red Sparrow) e Rebecca Hall (Godzilla vs. Kong). Il recente matrimonio tra Simon e Robyn viene sconvolto da un incontro casuale con un conoscente dell'uomo. Un segreto orribile del passato di Simon farà nascere in Robyn il dubbio su quanto realmente conosca il marito e il suo passato.

programme.title: THE ROMANTICS
programme.desc: Sette trentenni, compagni al college, si riuniscono dopo 6 anni per il matrimonio di Tom e Lila. La notte prima del matrimonio, Laura, damigella d'onore di Lila ed ex fiamma di Tom, e il promesso sposo scoprono di essere ancora innamorati.

programme.title: Un Appuntamento con il Destino
programme.desc: Uno scrittore si innamora di una ragazza i cui legami familiari interferiscono con la propria vita

programme.title: UN AMORE DI DAMIGELLA
programme.desc: Cate è la damigella della sua migliore amica quando incontra Matt, il fratello di Maxine. Scoppierà la scintilla tra i due?

programme.title: Se mi amate
programme.desc: Un medico si innamora della figlia di un paziente milionario in coma. Nonostante sia arrivato il momento di staccare la spina, il dottore deve combattere contro avvocati senza scrupoli che vogliono tenere l'uomo in vita, nell'interesse dell'ospedale.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Ballando a Lughnasa
programme.desc: Alla vigilia della guerra di Spagna, in un paese irlandese vive una famiglia composta da sole donne. Il ritorno a casa del fratello missionario in Africa fa emergere tensioni sentimentali troppo a lungo sopite.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.
